methods.name: Trans-UNet
methods.summary: A hybrid CNN-Transformer model for landslide mapping. It uses a hierarchical Transformer encoder for global context, a U-shaped full-scale feature extraction (U-FFE) module for local details, and a convolutional decoder (C-Decoder) for feature fusion and resolution restoration.
methods.source: Tianhe Ren, Wenping Gong, et al.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is linked and provided by the authors, while other input datasets are publicly accessible through established providers. The custom code is available via a persistent GitHub repository link.
